title: Harden advisory hook runner before trust-gate execution
instructions: Implement the pre-S4 hook runner hardening slice from references/initiatives/samantha-hook-system.md. Keep changes limited to src/core/hooks.ts and tests/hooks.test.ts. Do not add trust-gate execution, worker-dispatch integration, run-log integration, CLI integration, MCP, plugin, daemon, remote behavior, or repository hook artifacts. First, make hook process timeout completion bounded: on timeout send SIGTERM, allow a short grace period, and if the process has not closed then send SIGKILL; a hook command that ignores SIGTERM must still return timed_out advisory evidence instead of hanging. Add a focused test with a command that ignores SIGTERM. Second, add repo mutation detection around advisory hook command execution. Snapshot the repository tree before and after each hook command and record advisory evidence if the hook creates, modifies, or deletes repo files. This must remain fail-open evidence only: do not throw, block, or change advisory decisions because of mutation detection. Add a focused test with a hook command that writes a repo file and prove mutation evidence is recorded. Third, add HookResult status/decision consistency validation: passed may only use allow or none; blocked may only use block; advisory_failed, timed_out, and schema_invalid may only use none. Add tests proving invalid combinations are rejected as schema_invalid advisory evidence. Keep stdout raw retention behavior as-is for this slice except where necessary for the timeout hardening. Do not broaden HookResult authority or persistence.
